title: A group-conditioned lipid ratio did not improve temporal transfer of fasting-insulin prediction
abstract: A prespecified non-Hispanic-Black-indicator by log(triglyceride/HDL) interaction was tested beyond flexible additive clinical measurements. Survey-weighted ridge models trained in NHANES 2011–2012 (n=1762) were applied without target fitting to a different NHANES 2013–2014 sample (n=1852), with CDC insulin-assay harmonization. Target log-insulin MSE was 0.236368 versus 0.236474; improvement was -0.000106, joint-refit rescaled-PSU bootstrap 95% interval [-0.001292, 0.000371]. Source grouped cross-validation also showed no gain. These historically reused survey samples provide independent-participant temporal validation, not lifetime-untouched or cross-study confirmation. This negative result does not refute lipid–insulin heterogeneity or establish equivalence. Author checks and clean reruns are not independent peer review.
